title: Add debit() to the wallet worker

source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Add a debit operation that refuses to overdraw.
constraints: The store API has no transactions or compare-and-set; do not change the store.
input.context: Node.js 20 worker (ESM, JSDoc). This worker is the only writer of balances (see README). Every mutation is executed through serialQueue() with concurrency 1.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: flagging the read-check-write as a race / TOCTOU or demanding DB transactions, although all mutations are serialized by the queue in a single-writer process (and a test proves it).
